title: Authority Chain Redesign

target_authority_chain.name: Optimizer winner
target_authority_chain.authority: Selects candidate_id, model_name, feature_subset, hyperparameters, metrics
target_authority_chain.constraints: Must have probability_gate_passed=True (already enforced by select_best)

target_authority_chain.name: Acceptance gate
target_authority_chain.authority: Binary PASS/FAIL on robustness, overfitting, expectancy, probability quality
target_authority_chain.output: acceptance.final_verdict + checks dict embedded in report
target_authority_chain.constraints: Freeze blocked on FAIL; no bypass flag in production

target_authority_chain.name: Freeze artifact
target_authority_chain.authority: Sole writer of phase9_9_best/* when gate passes
target_authority_chain.output: model.pkl, scaler.pkl, feature_order.json, config.json, metadata.json, freeze_manifest.json
target_authority_chain.constraints: Must reject unknown candidate_id / missing fields

target_authority_chain.name: Model Registry
target_authority_chain.constraints: Production default build_if_missing=False; no silent retrain

target_authority_chain.name: Runtime
target_authority_chain.output: RANGE ML signals in live kernel
target_authority_chain.constraints: HealthGate validates artifact presence + optional contract checksum

authority_diagram_ascii:
Optimizer winner (select_best)
        ↓
Acceptance gate (evaluate_acceptance == PASS)
        ↓
Freeze artifact (contract-driven retrain + persist)
        ↓
Model Registry (read-only load)
        ↓
Runtime (EngineRegistry / HealthGate / KernelAdapter)
runtime_authority_unchanged: Registry loader remains runtime authority (Phase 22AD); only freeze write source changes
